class.name: TrackRenderingBackend
class.brief_description: What [TrackRenderingServer] forwards the drawing of a track to.
class.description: The renderer of one kind of track data ([method TrackData.get_rendering_backend]), registered by its name ([method TrackRenderingServer.backend_register]). It keeps what it draws of each track under the track's render RID, from [method track_create] to [method track_free], and reads the track's curves from [TrackServer] as it builds it.

method.name: topology_rebuilt
method.description: The joined tracks are other ones ([signal TrackServer.topology_rebuilt]).

method.name: track_build
method.description: Builds (or builds again) what the track draws.

method.name: track_clear
method.description: What the track drew goes as it leaves the camera's range; the track stays.

method.name: track_create
method.description: [TrackServer]'s [param track] is drawn by this backend under [param track_render].

method.name: track_free
method.description: What the track drew goes, and the track with it.

method.name: track_set_description
method.description: What the track is; given before it is streamed or built.

method.name: track_set_scenario
method.description: The world the track is drawn in.

method.name: track_set_switch_blade_offsets
method.description: The blades of a switch at the switch's offsets.

method.name: track_set_visible
method.description: Shows or hides what the track draws.

method.name: track_stream
method.description: Whether the backend streams the track itself ([code]true[/code]) or [TrackRenderingServer] registers it with [SceneryStreamingServer] ([code]false[/code]).
